root_cause_service.description: The service that is the root cause locus, as evidenced by span data.

root_cause_operation.description: The root-cause span name (operation) on that service.

mechanism.description: The failure mechanism, chosen from a fixed enum shared across scenarios.

mechanism_detail.description: Free text elaborating on the mechanism. Not graded.

cascading.description: Downstream failures that are symptoms of the root cause, not the cause itself.

evidence_span_ids.description: Span ids used as evidence for the verdict.

abstain.description: True when the span data cannot establish a root cause. When true, mechanism must be cannot_determine.
